messages:
noelle: Heads-up: top pantry shelf light/timer is tripping and the granola boxes keep tasting stale. spotted it twice this morning. anyone else? :frowning:
maya: saw it too yesterday. figured i flicked the switch when reaching for olive oil :grimacing:
devin: might be the motion sensor or the outlet. I can poke at it after lunch. want me to bring sealed tins for the loose stuff?
noelle: yes please. also someone keeps leaving half-open oats on the top shelf. can we do simple date labels?
sam: labeling + airtight bin works. I have 3 clear bins, can drop them tomorrow AM :thumbsup:
harriet: if we do labels, make them wipeable. whiteboard marker + date = easy.
ellie: added a kitchen quick-check to #people-ops checklist, ops-bot set a reminder.
ops-bot: Reminder set: Kitchen quick-check every Monday at 10:00 — rotate who checks seals, expiry, and labels. (added by ellie)
maya: pro tip: keep an Aeropress filter tin in the top drawer so coffee beans don't get humid when the shelf light is on. saved my morning.
devin: ha aeropress heroics. i can bring a desiccant pack. should we mark bins as "communal" vs "personal"?
noelle: colored sticker system: blue = communal, red = personal. visual and quick.
harriet: tiny schedule draft:
Mon: check seals + reseal bags
Wed: wipe shelf + swap desiccant if damp
Fri: expiry label check
Pin on inside pantry door?
sam: vote: tiny pantry budget jar for replacements? :coin:
noelle: +1, i'll seed $10 this week.
ellie: thanks! i'll pin schedule and update checklist.
maya: devin, if you bring tins + desiccant, i'll bring labels.
ops-bot: devin updated: "brings sealed tins and desiccant" scheduled for 2062008200. :robot_face:
noelle: also, whoever left half a bag of pistachios on the floor — claim them :laughing:
sam: not me. blame the office gremlin. :ghost:
maya: tiny win: coffee hopper beans now sealed. morning saved. :tada:
